converterRequires: run on a Mac; cannot be produced from the Linux builder

permissionMapping.scripting: supported on Safari 15.4+; verify executeScript on the target version
permissionMapping.downloads: NOT supported in Safari: channel.js returns a manual-save result; the popup instructs Copy file JSON + `fub-cli capture --file <it>`
permissionMapping.contextMenus: supported as contextMenus; verify menu labels on target version
permissionMapping.nativeMessaging: verify converter output: Safari maps to nativeMessaging in the containing app entitlements; NM host manifest installed by `fub-cli native-install` outside the browser
permissionMapping.notifications: supported; used ONLY as the openPopup fallback (menu gesture lost on some targets), never for capture content
permissionMapping.optional_host_permissions: verify converter mapping; Options > Origins + explicit browser grant required before any provider/image fetch

backgroundNote: Classic (non-module) service worker was chosen so the converter can map it to a background page on Safari versions without SW support; verify safari-build output before signing.
runUnsignedLocally: Safari -> Develop -> Allow Unsigned Extensions (macOS development only, re-allowed every browser launch)

signing.reason: no Apple Developer identity and no macOS toolchain on this Linux builder
requiredFor: running on Safari release without developer mode

iosNote: Out of scope for this extension package: on iOS capture travels via the MobileOwner share sheet producing the same capture-v1 payload; no iOS web-extension target is packaged here.
missingForStores: Firefox AMO signing (addons.mozilla.org submission; unbranded/Firefox ESR loads unsigned unpacked builds) — no submission performed, external credential
Chrome Web Store publishing (submission + review) — no submission performed, external credential
Safari App Store signing + listing review — no submission performed, external credential
chromeWebStoreNote: Load unpacked from apps/clipper with manifest.json; no build step. Minimum Chrome 109.
firefoxNote: Load temporary add-on from a scratch copy of apps/clipper with manifest.firefox.json renamed to manifest.json, or submit the zip from npm run package:firefox to AMO for signing. MV2 variant: popup/background use browser.tabs.executeScript fallback in src/popup.js and src/background.js; verify on ESR 115.
